Titel: Finance Transformation Lead – SAP S/4HANA (Freelance)
Unternehmen: Keppler Retail Group
Ort: Munich, Bavaria, Germany (Hybrid)
Quelle: LinkedIn
Link: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4187300106/
Abgerufen am: 19.09.2026 07:30

About the role
Keppler Retail Group operates 340 stores across Germany, Austria and Switzerland. We are replacing our legacy finance landscape with SAP S/4HANA and redesigning our finance target operating model at the same time. We are looking for a freelance Finance Transformation Lead to drive the business side of this programme.

Responsibilities
Lead the finance workstream of the S/4HANA programme together with the IT programme manager
Define the future finance processes (record-to-report, purchase-to-pay, controlling)
Own change management and communication for about 180 finance users
Set up KPI reporting for the CFO and the steering committee
Manage the external implementation partners

Requirements
10+ years in finance, ideally with a background in controlling or accounting
Proven track record in at least two finance transformation or ERP projects
Strong stakeholder management and presentation skills at C-level
Experience with project management methods (classic and agile)
Fluent English and German

Nice to have
Retail experience
Power BI or SAP Analytics Cloud

What we offer
12-month engagement starting in January 2027, full-time. Hybrid set-up with two days per week in our Munich office. Please include your daily rate in your application.
